Hi Sophie,

Thanks — Wed Mar 11 should be fine from our side. Quick clarification: US daylight savings starts on Sun, Mar 8 this year, so ET will shift from UTC-5 to UTC-4. The time mapping you suggested (10:00 AM AEDT -> 8:00 PM ET) is accurate for the weekend before Mar 8, but after Mar 8 the offset changes.

To avoid confusion across the changeover, would you prefer we schedule the demo using UTC times in the invite (UTC 01:00 on Mar 11) or explicitly include both local times with timezones in the calendar event? Another option is to move the call one day earlier (Tue Mar 10) at 9:00 AM AEDT / Tue Mar 10 7:00 PM ET so it's before the DST switch on our side.

- Add an explicit note in the body: "US participants will be on EDT after Mar 8; times reflect updated offsets"
- Send an updated .ics that sets the timezone explicitly (Australia/Sydney) and rely on attendee calendar clients to convert.

Naomi: can you take point on sending the updated invite once Sophie confirms the date?
